headline: OMNITUBE 2 is here: Omni Shorts, Channel Doctor and 7 app languages
notes: 2.0.2: project tabs (Script, Voice, Look, Cast, Storyboard) work again, Documentary Studio look step fixed, full version shown (Windows and Mac)
Omni Shorts (Pro): type a topic and get a finished Short drawn in code, in 8 styles (Tall Tale, Cutaway, Deep Dive, Night File, Build Site, Inside Out, Stick Story, Paper Atlas)
Pick the writer: an API writer for the best look (Claude Sonnet on OpenRouter, about $0.08 per Short) or a free model on your PC
Make with Claude: Claude Desktop writes the video, OMNITUBE voices and renders it
Long videos in chapters, Batch Builder with a posting plan, Channels with style, voice, look and upload texts
Upload kit for every Short: 3 titles, description, tags and a thumbnail, plus a picture check
Channel Doctor (free): paste your channel link, get a score and clear tips
Welcome setup: choose Pro, Free local or Omni Shorts, only what you pick is downloaded
App languages: English, Arabic, Spanish, Hindi, Urdu, Portuguese and French
New glass look, new menu (Omni Cinema and Omni Shorts), Settings and Pro pages with tabs, help popups
Free for every OMNITUBE buyer, Pro and Lifetime: your key keeps working
